recommended_title: Sea Monster Survival: 30 Days Stranded at Sea
alternative_title: You Have 30 Days to Survive Sea Monsters
description:
Thirty days. One broken fishing boat. Something enormous beneath the waves.

Follow Marin as a sea monster attack turns an ordinary trip into a fight to reach safety. A giant shark, a crushing tentacle, a sinking boat—and one final chance to escape.

An original animated survival story from Deep Sea Survival.
